visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men sit on a bright yellow sofa in a modern indoor studio setting. The man on the left, wearing a black textured shirt, holds a smartphone and points at the screen toward the man on the right. The man on the right wears a grey fleece jacket and holds a white book. Behind them is a metallic shelf with awards. (2) A transition cuts to archival footage of a man in a black t-shirt and striped socks lifting a massive weight bar outdoors. The background shows a white tent and spectators. Large yellow text overlays appear at the bottom. (3) The scene returns to the two men on the sofa. The man in black continues gesturing toward his phone while the man in grey listens intently, his facial expression shifting to curiosity. (4) A still image of a muscular man (Patrik Baboumian) holding a sword vertically is displayed. He is shirtless with large arm muscles. The background is dark. Yellow and white text blocks overlay the center of the frame. (5) Another still image shows Patrik Baboumian biting into a bundle of green leafy vegetables. He has long hair and a beard, flexing his bicep. Logos for PETA and Wiki appear in the corners. (6) Back on the sofa, the man in black holds up a packet of 'BeRule' protein powder while talking. The man in grey looks at the packet with an impressed facial expression. (7) A close-up shot focuses on three white packets of 'BeRule Plant-Based Protein' standing on a wooden table. Hand gestures from the host highlight the packaging design, which features green graphics. (8) A series of close-up shots show a white nutritional information label on the back of the packet, followed by a graphic illustrating six types of plant-based protein sources like peas, rice, and soy. (9) A close-up shows a green 'BeRule' packet being held and opened, revealing the white interior. (10) The two men appear together again, each holding a 'BeRule' packet. The man in grey gives a thumbs up. A large text overlay at the bottom provides a call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Information Sharing -> Problem Identification -> Solution Presentation -> Benefits Breakdown -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a 'did you know' hook featuring a famous vegan strongman (Patrik Baboumian) to address a common skepticism about vegan diets and muscle building. It then transitions into a product endorsement for BeRule plant-based protein, highlighting its high protein content, lack of lactose, and variety of flavors to appeal to fitness enthusiasts and the general public.
